title: AI-Powered Price Negotiation Solution (Nego-Wiz)
summary: AI O2O reports that Nego-Wiz shortened negotiations at KT Commerce during a 2024–25 pilot. The chapter does not quantify the time saved.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: AI O2O reports that Nego-Wiz shortened negotiations at KT Commerce during a 2024–25 pilot. The chapter does not quantify the time saved. KT Commerce pilot, December 2024–March 2025. The chapter reports the stated benefit but does not independently verify it.
purpose: Automate corporate price negotiations and reduce staff workload.

ratings.reason: The supplier reports that KT Commerce shortened negotiations during its pilot. This is an operational time saving, with no amount supplied.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
